title: Eye-BCI Motor Execution dataset from Guttmann-Flury et al 2025
description: A BIDS-formatted EEG dataset of two-class hand-grasping motor tasks (left vs. right hand) from 31 healthy participants, recorded with a 64-channel Neuroscan system at 1000 Hz across up to three sessions of 40 trials each. It is a derivative of the multi-paradigm Eye-BCI dataset, which combines EEG, eye-tracking and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis. It is provided through MOABB for benchmarking motor-related brain-computer interface decoding.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan Quik-Cap (64 EEG channels plus EOG and stimulus channels) and SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz, referenced to the right mastoid with a forehead ground. Participants followed visual rectangle cues to perform left or right hand grasping, with 40 trials per session and up to 3 sessions per subject. Events are annotated with HED 8.4.0.
